title: Fixed-coordinate identity-composition square for finite partial tensor
statement: After applying the full fixed-coefficient coordinate functor and postcomposing with targetCoordinates, the finite partial tensor identity-composition component equation holds.

source.place: First paragraph, fixed-coefficient expansion of the identity-composition component calculation.

proof.text: Use the prescribed pullback coordinate isomorphisms p and q (q is the restriction to the finite-Tor full subcategory), and the tensor coordinate isomorphism from the inverse coefficient unit. Prove naturality of p and of the tensor coordinate components from pullback comparison naturality and unit naturality. No naturality assertion for q is needed.
Apply pullbackComposition_fixed_coordinates to the two identity maps, with equality transport along id_comp. Restrict the resulting compositor square to the finite-Tor inclusion for the second input.

Use pullbackTensor_fixed_coordinates and cancellation of the first-input pullback isomorphism to express each finite tensor comparison as a square against the uncurried fixed-scalar tensor comparison.

The proved categorical transport lemma pastes the two tensor squares, using naturality of p, the tensor coordinate isomorphism and the fixed-scalar tensor comparison. Cancel their invertible target factors. The remaining equation is leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_identityComposition, transported along id_comp and the explicit equality between the underlying scheme map of the space identity and the scheme identity. Postcompose the resulting equality by targetCoordinates.

proof_origin.place: First paragraph: compatibility of the prescribed pullback composition with coefficient realization, before the tensor identity calculation.

lean.statement: theorem finitePartialTensor_identityComponent_coordinates (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn) (X : SixFunctorSpace D) : let U := S.finite.pull (𝟙 X) let V := CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull S (𝟙 X) let T := Functor.uncurry.obj (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S X) let c : ∀ M, U.obj M ≅ U.obj (U.obj M) := fun M ↦ eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (S.finite.pull f).obj M) (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X)).symm) ≪≫ (S.finite.pullComposition (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X)).app M let d : ∀ L, V.obj L ≅ V.obj (V.obj L) := fun L ↦ eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull S f).obj L) (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X)).symm) ≪≫ CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPullComposition S (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) L ∀ (M : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X) (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn X.obj.left), (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).map ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.pullbackTensorComparison S (𝟙 X) M L).hom ≫ T.map (Prod.mkHom (c M).hom (d L).hom)) ≫ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.targetCoordinates S (𝟙 X) (U.obj (U.obj M)) (V.obj L)).hom = (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).map ((c (T.obj (M, L))).hom ≫ U.map ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.pullbackTensorComparison S (𝟙 X) M L).hom) ≫ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.pullbackTensorComparison S (𝟙 X) (U.obj M) (V.obj L)).hom) ≫ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.targetCoordinates S (𝟙 X) (U.obj (U.obj M)) (V.obj L)).hom
